data.plain_english: A report said US and European government borrowing costs, known as interest rates on bonds, turned lower. Lower rates can help technology and property companies, which are often hurt when borrowing is expensive. The council leans towards Hong Kong technology and property and US technology doing better, but is not very sure, because US rates were still much higher over the past month. The council is most divided on US property, where some see relief and others doubt it. Mainland China's market was closed for a holiday, so its data is out of date. This is research to help you think, not advice to buy or sell.
